relation_specs.definition: Reverse causal-context family: an effect/result is explained by a cause/reason. The normalized record graph is dense lexical context, not a single sparse proposition edge.
Forward causal-context family: a cause/reason leads to an effect/result. The normalized record graph is dense lexical context, not a single sparse proposition edge.

layer01.source: derive only from document tokens; do not read normalized gold entity inventory

layer02.record_relation_family: Choose one controlled family for the record from visible type/text only: BECAUSE for effect/reason constructions, THEREFORE for cause/consequence constructions.
layer02.density_note: Within the selected family, the normalized graph is dense lexical causal context; do not force sparse proposition-level semantics.
layer02.text_order: Never orient pair edges solely by surface order.

projection: After Layer 12 only, a predicted lexical label maps deterministically to EVENT_ + first16(md5(label)).
gold_policy: Gold lexical nodes and BECAUSE/THEREFORE edges are loaded only after Layer 12.
